verdict.rationale: The evidence documents RUN's new-hire onboarding only as UI and employee self-service flows: electronic paperwork, W-4 and direct deposit (adp-run-docs-26), and e-I-9 (adp-run-docs-29). It also describes ADP API Central generically (OAuth, use-case templates, 'automate HR processes'), but nothing shows API endpoints that create an employee, set compensation, or configure tax setup in RUN, so an agent-driven end-to-end hire via API is unevidenced. A generic API-platform claim is not this story's capability and earns no credit.
